{"name": "set_contract", "arguments": {"question": "What is the mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL) among patients with SEVERE disease in the trial?", "estimand": "Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL) among patients with SEVERE disease", "population": "Patients with SEVERE disease in the trial", "units": "ng/mL", "premises": ["The `biomarker_baseline` column contains `-999` as a sentinel value for failed QC, not a measurement.", "The dataset contains duplicate `patient_id`s due to re-testing, and only the row with the highest `sample_seq` per patient should be used.", "The `arm` assignment is not randomised, but this question only asks about `severity`, so confounding by `arm` is not relevant here."], "assumptions": ["All non-sentinel `biomarker_baseline` values are valid and in ng/mL.", "The `severity` column accurately reflects baseline disease severity."}}
